import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { ExportImportDataService } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-calculators', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
Financial & Trade Analytics

Keya Trade Calculation Suite

Automated Landed Cost Calculator for Raw Material Imports & Net Profit Margin Engine for Exports.

@if (activeCalc() === 'IMPORT_COST') {
RAW MATERIAL IMPORT

Import Landed Cost Calculation Inputs

CIF Chattogram Port
Landed Cost Calculation Results
Total Landed Import Cost:
{{ dataService.formatValue(getImportTotalLandedCost()) }}
Base FOB Price:{{ dataService.formatValue(impFobPrice * impQty) }}
Ocean Freight:{{ dataService.formatValue(impFreight * impQty) }}
Marine Insurance:{{ dataService.formatValue(impInsurance * impQty) }}
Customs Duty ({{ impDutyPercent }}%):{{ dataService.formatValue(getImportDutyCost()) }}
Port & C&F Expenses:{{ dataService.formatValue(impPortCnf * impQty) }}
Landed Unit Price / {{ impUnit }}: {{ dataService.formatValue(getImportLandedUnitPrice()) }}
} @if (activeCalc() === 'EXPORT_PROFIT') {
GARMENTS EXPORT PROFIT

Export Profit Margin Calculation Inputs

FOB Commercial Invoice
Export Profitability Results
Total Gross Export Sales Revenue:
{{ dataService.formatValue(getExportTotalRevenue()) }}
Total Production Cost:{{ dataService.formatValue(getExportTotalProductionCost()) }}
Net Profit Amount (USD):{{ dataService.formatValue(getExportNetProfit()) }}
Net Export Profit Margin (%): +{{ getExportProfitMarginPercent().toFixed(1) }}%
}
` }) export class CalculatorsComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); activeCalc = signal<'IMPORT_COST' | 'EXPORT_PROFIT'>('IMPORT_COST'); // Import Landed Cost Model impName = 'Australian High Combing Raw Cotton Bales'; impQty = 1200; impUnit = 'Bales'; impFobPrice = 390.0; impFreight = 24.5; impInsurance = 3.8; impDutyPercent = 9.0; // 9% Customs duty impPortCnf = 13.6; getImportDutyCost(): number { return (this.impFobPrice * this.impQty) * (this.impDutyPercent / 100); } getImportTotalLandedCost(): number { const base = (this.impFobPrice + this.impFreight + this.impInsurance + this.impPortCnf) * this.impQty; return base + this.getImportDutyCost(); } getImportLandedUnitPrice(): number { return this.getImportTotalLandedCost() / (this.impQty || 1); } // Export Profit Model expOrderTitle = '100% Organic Pique Polo Shirts (Order #EXP-SO-8812)'; expQty = 42500; expSellingFob = 5.00; expYarnCost = 2.40; expCmtCost = 1.10; expFreightCost = 0.30; getExportTotalRevenue(): number { return this.expSellingFob * this.expQty; } getExportTotalProductionCost(): number { return (this.expYarnCost + this.expCmtCost + this.expFreightCost) * this.expQty; } getExportNetProfit(): number { return this.getExportTotalRevenue() - this.getExportTotalProductionCost(); } getExportProfitMarginPercent(): number { const rev = this.getExportTotalRevenue(); if (!rev) return 0; return (this.getExportNetProfit() / rev) * 100; } }
